description: Free search of the Up To Tech investor map: thousands of venture capital, private equity, corporate, accelerator and public investors, by sector, country, stage, round size, cheque, assets under management, age, activity and available contact. Each one is proven live (recent deal or live site) and comes with a way in: pitch form, business email, contact page or LinkedIn. Ranked by the deals they really made in the last three years. Use it when someone asks which investors or VCs to contact, or who funds a sector or a country.

active_since.description: Last recorded deal on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

aum_max.description: Maximum assets under management, in euros

aum_min.description: Minimum assets under management, in euros (known for part of the firms)

based_in.description: Country where the firm is based, anywhere in the world, e.g. United States, Singapore, France (known or inferred for most firms)

cheque.description: Your cheque, in euros: only firms whose site states a cheque size near it or a range that includes it (few do)

country.description: Country of the startups they back, or of the firm's headquarters when known, e.g. France, UK, Germany, United States

founded_after.description: Firm founded (or first recorded deal) in or after this year

founded_before.description: Firm founded (or first recorded deal) in or before this year

has_contact.description: Only firms with a contact page, pitch form or business email

has_website.description: Only firms whose website is known

kind.description: vc (venture and other investment firms), pe (private equity), corporate, accelerator, crowdfunding, bank, public

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 40. Default 15

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page

round_max.description: Maximum of their typical (median) round, in euros

round_min.description: Minimum of their typical (median) round, in euros. It is the size of the whole round, not their cheque

sector.description: Sector, e.g. AI, Software, Fintech, Healthtech, Energy, Cleantech, Deeptech, Cybersecurity, Robotics, Defence, Space

stage.description: Stage of rounds they joined, or stage named on their site

status.description: active (European deal in the last 12 months), quiet (older deals only), open (no recorded European deal, but a live site)

name: find_investors
title: Find investors (VC, PE, corporate, public)
